resources.string: Scroll Stopper detects short-form video UI layouts (Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts) to prevent doom-scrolling while keeping your standard feeds and direct messages accessible.
Intercept addictive short-form video algorithms without giving up social messaging or normal feeds.
Scroll Stopper uses Accessibility APIs strictly to detect short-video UI layouts on Instagram and YouTube. No personal data, messages, or text inputs are recorded, stored, or transmitted.
Targeted UI inspection: Recognizes Reels and Shorts view containers in real-time.
DM Exception: Watch single Reels shared in chat, but prevents the endless scroll.
Zero-Cloud Guarantee: 100% on-device processing. No network tracking.
Single Reel viewed. Further scrolling blocked to protect your time.
YouTube Shorts blocked. Back to intentional watching!
